interface.longDescription: Read-only EU free-movement and EU-family visa guidance with model-led routing, evidence-gated research, legal-source review, and controlled synthetic eudirective tools. Explicit consultations and material continuation changes receive a full native-Markdown consultation board in the assistant's reply, showing scope, operation status, selected C27 checks, source use, and relevant modules. Source accounting separates matches to records in the bundled plugin library from sources found through web search, while marking those model-reported discovery counts as unknown when provenance is missing. Partial and unavailable items name the missing information and its effect. The board reports model-led work honestly; skill instructions do not authenticate activity or enforce answer release. Includes the externally maintained EU and national source library mirrored into the plugin package. The bundled corpus is a versioned snapshot; consult official publishers to confirm live currentness. Personal use is intended. Non-personal use for an employer, business, organization, client, customer or other third party, paid services, or deploying the plugin for others requires a license; request one at eudirective@proton.me.
